name: Bangkok/ Don Mueang International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 03L/21R, is 3,700 m long and 60 m wide

handling.v: MJETS Limited is listed as handling agent for private aircraft only, alongside AOT Ground Aviation Services (AOTGA)
handling.quote: MJETS LIMITED ... Private Aircraft only; AOT GROUND AVIATION SERVICES CO., LTD. (AOTGA)

slots.v: Level 3 (coordinated) airport: slots are coordinated by CAAT and non-scheduled flights must obtain a slot (business aviation applies with a General Aviation Clearance Request, GCR)
slots.quote: L3 | DMK/VTBD | Coordination | CAAT; Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

permits.v: non-scheduled flights (including private flights) need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead through the online system (FPOS)
permits.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance
